acceptance_criteria.text: The matchmaking engine pairs a player with an opponent within 200 ms of request, regardless of platform.
A secure peer-to-peer or client-server session is established with mutual authentication before gameplay starts.
When a player joins, the session state is synchronized to all participants within 100 ms.
If a player disconnects, the session remains active for up to 30 seconds to allow reconnection; after that, the session terminates gracefully and notifies remaining players.
The system logs all session lifecycle events (join, leave, reconnect, termination) with timestamps for audit.
